contents.text: Contents: section 2 Route requirements, page 2; Table 1 Route widths, pages 3–4. Related authority: Supplement S1, Exceptions; Notice N1, Route closures.

route-rule.text: Section 2. Route widths follow Table 1, subject to Supplement S1. Apply both the relevant table row and any applicable exception.

table-first.text: Table 1. Route type | Minimum clear width | Additional control. Ground-level public route | 2.0 m | Keep the full width clear. Continued on page 4.

table-continuation.text: Table 1 continued. Route type | Minimum clear width | Additional control. Raised public route | 2.4 m | Provide edge protection. Supplement S1 may qualify this row.

maintenance-exception.text: Supplement S1. A raised route used only for maintenance may have a 1.5 m clear width if access is locked against public use. Edge protection remains required. Public routes cannot use this exception.
